items.scope: CVEs requested by code owners using the GitHub Security Advisories feature and vulnerabilities affecting open source projects discovered by security researchers at GitHub or Microsoft not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in products and services under the Canon brand.
openGauss issues only.
All Bitdefender products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bitdefender that are not in another CNA’s scope.

Products supported by Schneider Electric and its affiliates, including products branded Schneider Electric or any other brands owned or controlled by Schneider Electric (such as but not limited to APC, Eliwell, Proface, ProLeit, Lauritz Knudsen Electrical & Automation, etc.), excluding Aveva and RIB products.
All currently supported PTC software products and cloud/SaaS services.
All products and services developed and/or sold by Panasonic Group companies.
Vulnerabilities related to TCS-CERT’s customers’ environment and vulnerabilities related to research conducted by Cyber Solutions by Thales’ Intrusion and Application Security Team.
Jaspersoft products and services only.

All BeyondTrust products, including PasswordSafe, Privileged Remote Access, Remote Support, Privilege Management for Windows/Mac, Privilege Management for Unix/Linux, Identity Security Insights, Active Directory (AD) Bridge, and Total PASM.
Intel branded products and technologies and Intel managed open source projects.
N-able branded products and technologies only.
Vulnerability assignment related to its vulnerability coordination role.
Hitachi products excluding Hitachi Energy and Hitachi Vantara products.
Bosch products only.
ELAN issues only.
All Gallagher security products only.
All Omnissa products and services, including Workspace ONE and Horizon.
Vulnerabilities in software discovered by NCSC-FI, and vulnerabilities reported to NCSC-FI for coordinated disclosure, which are not in another CNA’s scope.
All HiddenLayer systems, services, and products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by HiddenLayer that are not in another CNA’s scope.

Vulnerabilities in the AHA! website and other AHA! controlled assets, as well as vulnerabilities identified in assets owned, operated, or maintained by another organization unless covered by the scope of another CNA.
All HashiCorp products and projects unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
All HDF software including HDF5, HDF4, HSDS, HDFView.
All OpenText products (including Carbonite, Zix, Micro Focus, others).
StrongDM issues only.
Xpdf open source project, including the xpdf viewer and associated command line tools.
All ConnectWise products and services and vulnerabilities discovered by ConnectWise in third party products that are not within another CNA’s scope.
Everpure (formerly Pure Storage, Inc.) products only.
All upKeeper Solutions products, excluding end-of-life (EOL) as listed in the upKeeper Solutions End of Life Policy.
All HYPR products only.
Snowflake products, including those of its subsidiaries, and vulnerabilities in third-party software that are discovered by, or reported to, Snowflake that are not within another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities related to products of Mitsubishi Electric Group.
Pegasystems products only.
Qualcomm and Snapdragon issues only.
Vulnerabilities in the following Altium products only: Altium Designer, A365, Octopart, and Altium Enterprise Server.
Trend Micro supported products, including any end-of-life products.

Any Seagate or LaCie software or hardware, open or closed source, supported and end of life, as well as any vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Seagate that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All Mattermost issues, and vulnerabilities discovered by Mattermost that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Teltonika Networks products and services only.
Vulnerabilities discovered in Extreme Networks, Inc.’s products and services.
All Airbus products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Airbus that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All current products/software/apps made by Logitech, Ultimate Ears, Jaybird, Streamlabs, Logitech G, Logicool, Blue, and Astro Gaming.
Citrix issues only.
Vulnerabilities in vendor products discovered by BLSOPS, or related parties, while performing vulnerability research or security assessments, unless covered by another CNA’s scope.

Meta-supported open source projects, mobile apps, and other software, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Meta that are not in another CNA’s scope; see: https://www.facebook.com/whitehat and https://github.com/facebook/.
Yokogawa Group companies’ products and Yokogawa Group subsidiaries’ products.
Adobe issues only.

System vulnerabilities regarding the Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch Lite, and vulnerabilities regarding Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch applications for which Nintendo is the publisher worldwide.
Zabbix products and Zabbix projects listed on https://git.zabbix.com/ only.
Bizerba products only.
